0022600178.text: The Grizzlies (6-1) host the Indiana Pacers (2-6), with Memphis 2-1 at home after a loss in its most recent game, and Memphis sits second in the Southwest, 0.5 games back, and second in the West. Indiana has dropped five straight, is 0-4 at home, and ranks 12th in the East and 4.5 games back in the Central, while Memphis is without Scotty Pippen Jr. (back soreness) and Indiana is missing Ben Sheppard (knee), Ivica Zubac (ankle sprain), Johnny Furphy (knee surgery), Obi Toppin (back soreness), T.J. McConnell (hamstring strain), and Tyrese Haliburton (hamstring strain), with Kelly Oubre Jr. (knee bruise) listed as day-to-day and a game-time decision. The 2026-27 season series has no games yet, and the Grizzlies won the 2025-26 series 2-0, including a 125-106 victory in Indianapolis on March 1, 2026.
